evals.prompt: Cascade these company OKRs to our three teams (platform, growth, mobile). O1: Become the default choice for mid-market DevOps teams — KR1: net revenue retention 115%, KR2: launch the v2 platform. O2: Operational excellence — KR1: 99.95% availability. Cycle: Q4.
assertions: Company OKRs appear verbatim; 'launch the v2 platform' is flagged as an output KR with the outcome it presumably serves
Each team KR has a written causal sentence naming the company KR it feeds and the mechanism
Each team KR has baseline → target and is scorable 0.0–1.0 — no binary 'complete the migration' KRs
Not every team is forced under every objective — teams with no credible contribution are omitted from that objective
A ranked gap registry is present (or explicitly states none found and why that is suspicious)
A causal metric tree with exactly one north-star is emitted; every team KR is attached, labeled guardrail, or explicitly cut
The north-star is user-behavioral, not 'features shipped' or another output
Next steps route team KRs to success-metrics for measurement design and gaps to a named decision owner

evals.prompt: [Non-interactive run — no user available to answer questions] Cascade our OKRs to the teams.
assertions: No company OKRs are invented — the output is BLOCKED: need the company OKRs, verbatim
The BLOCKED output states what to rerun with (the top 3-5 objectives and their KRs, plus teams in scope)
No cascade tables, gap registry, or metric tree appear

evals.prompt: I'm the planning lead for our library system. quillfield_2027.md has the board-approved system OKRs for 2027 and each team's draft OKRs. Cascade the system OKRs into team OKRs, fix what's wrong with the drafts, and tell me where the plan doesn't hold together. The director wants it to fit on two pages, with no more than 3 objectives per team.
assertions: Flags that the 16–24 sign-up key result has no team that credibly owns it (the Teen Services post was eliminated), rather than quietly assigning it to a team that lacks the capacity
Catches that the branch visit targets add up to 1.28M, short of the system target of 1.38M
Catches that Eastgate is closed March through August 2027 yet its draft target is unchanged at 200,000 visits
Flags the social media impressions key result as not moving e-book and audiobook lending (or as a vanity metric) and replaces or drops it
Catches that 120 sessions in 4-session courses of 10 seats allows at most about 300 completions, far short of the 1,500 target, or otherwise shows the Adult Learning draft cannot deliver it
Does not invent teams, staff, budgets, or baseline figures not in the input
Keeps each team to at most 3 objectives and the whole within roughly two pages

evals.prompt: my sister and i run a bakery, just us plus 2 staff. our accountant says we should do 'OKRs' for next year?? we want to start opening sundays and get more cafes buying our bread wholesale. can you just give us the table, nothing fancy
assertions: Delivers the OKRs without stopping to ask clarifying questions first
The reply is essentially just a table, with at most a line or two of text around it
Covers both goals the user named: opening on Sundays and winning more wholesale café customers
Key results are measurable results (for example Sunday takings or number of wholesale accounts) rather than tasks such as making a flyer
Does not invent current figures (revenue, customer counts) as facts; missing baselines are left to fill in or labelled as assumptions
Sized for a four-person business — a small number of objectives, not a multi-department corporate cascade
